transcript.text: I reviewed the dependency manifest and found that the toolkit links to a core library distributed only under AGPL-3.0. This means the release must use AGPL-3.0-only and provide the corresponding source for the linked toolkit code. I've kept this analysis in my release-gate working papers pending this meeting.

transcript.text: I've completed my privacy review of the release package. I examined the training-corpus records and found 37 customer support records containing personal data. Based on this finding, the public package must exclude the training corpus entirely. The source code and model weights may still be released after that exclusion. I've retained the record-level review in my privacy workpapers pending this approval meeting.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I've completed my commercial-contracts review. I checked the executed enterprise-customer agreements and found that the performance benchmark package contains customer-specific results whose public disclosure is prohibited under those contracts. The release must exclude the benchmark package entirely. I've recorded the contract restriction in the commercial review file pending this approval meeting.
